MONOPOLY CONTROL AUTHORITY (SUPPLY OF INFORMATION) RULES, 1995
MONOPOLY CONTROL AUTHORITY (SUPPLY OF INFORMATION) RULES, 1995
[Gazette of Pakistan, Part IV, 8th November, 1995]
No. 75(I)MCA/Admn/76. In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 24 read with Practices (Control and Prevention) Ordinance, 1970(V of 1970)
the Monopoly control Authority hereby makes the following rule:--
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑(1) These Rules may
be called the Monopoly Control Authority (Supply of Information) Rules, 1995.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.‑‑(1) In these rules, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑‑
(a) "Ordinance" means
the Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (Control and Prevention)
Ordinance, 1970 (V of 1970);
(b) "undertaking" means
any concern, institution, establishment or enterprise engaged in the
production, supply or distribution of goods, or in the provision or control of
any service.
(2) All other terms and
expressions shall have the same meanings as are assigned to them in the
Ordinance.
3. Supply of information.‑‑An undertaking the total
value of assets of which is not less than one hundred and fifty million rupees
shall furnish to the Authority every year, within six months of the closing of
its financial year, the following information:‑‑‑
(a) particulars of its
shareholder who together with his relatives as set out in Schedule I to these
Rules owns, holds or controls shares carrying not less than fifty percent. of
the voting power in it;
(b) particulars of its
shareholders who obtained or gave proxies to other shareholders as set out in
Schedule 11 to these Rules for exercising influence over its management or
policies;
(c) names and addresses of other
undertakings which own, hold or control shares in it and are owned, managed, or
controlled by shareholders mentioned in clause (a) above;
(d) 3 copies of its annual report
and audited accounts including balance sheet and profit and loss account;
(e) particulars of persons who
own, hold or control share carrying not less than thirty percent. of the voting
power in it as set out in Schedule III to these Rules;
(f) list of Directors alongwith
information about their inter se relationship, if any;
(g) position held by its
Directors, Chief Executive, Managing Partner or Secretary in other
undertaking(s) as set out in Schedule IV to these Rules ;
(h) detail of its dealings with
the associated undertaking(s) as set out in Schedule V to these Rules;
(i) volume of its business as.
set out in Schedule VI to these Rules;
(j) copy of each agreement
entered into or memorandum signed by it or on its behalf as is referred to in
clauses (i), (j), (k) and (1) of subsection (1) of section 16 of the Ordinance.
